name: Vonage
description: Send text messages and place voice calls through Vonage.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The sender ID or phone number that text messages are sent from.

fields.description: The Vonage voice application's private key, used to sign the voice API JWT.

fields.name: fromPhoneVoice
